justification: Image A depicts an anthropomorphic figure with an elaborate feathered or profile-creature headdress, seated and holding an object, rendered in a carved relief style; image B depicts a vertical stone monument covered in rows of glyph-like blocks with no discernible figural or animal imagery. There is no correspondence in the kinds of elements depicted (figure vs. abstract sign blocks), their relationships, or arrangement, so the only faint similarity is the shared use of low-relief carving convention on a hard material.
